descricao: Verbos no passado, passado contínuo, can e could e leitura de parágrafos no 7º ano, com degrau para o verbo to be e a localização de informações.
reviewNote: conteúdo SpeakFlow, em revisão pela equipe pedagógica

items.question: Qual é o passado de "go"?
items.audioScript: Pergunta 1. Qual é o passado de "go"? A: goed; B: go; C: going; D: went.

items.question: Complete: "We have a test ___ Friday."
items.audioScript: Pergunta 2. Complete: "We have a test ___ Friday." A: on; B: in; C: at; D: of.

items.question: Complete: "I ___ TV when you called." (watch)
items.explanation: A ação estava em andamento quando a ligação aconteceu: was watching.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 3. Complete: "I ___ TV when you called." (watch) A: watched; B: was watching; C: was watch; D: were watching.

items.question: Complete: "They ___ soccer when it started to rain." (play)
items.explanation: Com "they", usamos "were" e o verbo com -ing.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 4. Complete: "They ___ soccer when it started to rain." (play) A: was playing; B: were play; C: were playing; D: play.

items.question: Qual frase está correta?
items.explanation: "Can" não muda e o verbo depois dele fica na forma simples.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 5. Qual frase está correta? A: She cans swim.; B: She can to swim.; C: She does can swim.; D: She can swim..

items.question: Complete: "When I was four, I ___ read."
items.explanation: "When I was four" é passado. A negativa de could é "couldn't".
items.audioScript: Pergunta 6. Complete: "When I was four, I ___ read." A: couldn't; B: can't; C: didn't could; D: couldn't to.

items.question: Leia: "Cats are clean animals. They wash their fur many times a day." Qual é a ideia principal?
items.explanation: A primeira frase traz a ideia principal. A segunda dá o detalhe que a explica.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 7. Leia: "Cats are clean animals. They wash their fur many times a day." Qual é a ideia principal? A: Gatos lavam o pelo; B: Gatos são animais limpos; C: Gatos dormem muito; D: Gatos são melhores que cães.

items.question: Leia: "My parents work in a hospital." Quem trabalha no hospital?
items.explanation: "Parents" significa pai e mãe. É um falso cognato.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 8. Leia: "My parents work in a hospital." Quem trabalha no hospital? A: Os parentes; B: Os primos; C: Os pais; D: Os vizinhos.

items.question: Complete: "She ___ a student."
items.explanation: Com he, she e it, usamos "is".
items.audioScript: Pergunta 9. Complete: "She ___ a student." A: am; B: are; C: be; D: is.

items.question: Complete: "They ___ my friends."
items.explanation: Com you, we e they, usamos "are".
items.audioScript: Pergunta 10. Complete: "They ___ my friends." A: are; B: is; C: am; D: be.

items.question: Leia: "The party is on Saturday at 4 o'clock." Quando é a festa?
items.audioScript: Pergunta 11. Leia: "The party is on Saturday at 4 o'clock." Quando é a festa? A: No domingo; B: No sábado; C: Na sexta; D: Às 6 horas.

items.question: Leia: "Name: Julia. Age: 11. City: Recife." Quantos anos Julia tem?
items.explanation: "Age" significa idade. A ficha informa: Age: 11.
items.audioScript: Pergunta 12. Leia: "Name: Julia. Age: 11. City: Recife." Quantos anos Julia tem? A: 12; B: Recife; C: 11; D: Não diz.
